name: LLMCheck: Apple M5 Max (64GB), Ollama, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M decode
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LLMCheck open dataset). M5 Max 64GB, Ollama, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M, TTFT 0.8 s, per-request decode.
notes: Lower-RAM (64GB) M5 Max config; same ballpark as the 128GB MLX run, confirming the figure is bandwidth-bound not capacity-bound at this model size.
